simple.meaning: מְכוּרָה (mᵉkûwrâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “origin (as if a mine).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Ezekiel, beginning at Ezekiel 16:3. Its contexts include family, kingship, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְכוּרָה (H4351).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְכוּרָה (mᵉkûwrâh) / H4351 is traced through Ezekiel 16:3, Ezekiel 21:35, Ezekiel 29:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H4351. mekurah or mekorah [ מְכוּרָה מְכֹרָה, ] noun feminine origin (i.e. place of digging out?) — singular suffix מְכוּרָתָם אֶרֶץ Ezek 29:14 ; of a people, persons: plural suffix מְכֻרוֺתַיִךְ בְּאֶרֶץ Ezekiel 21:35 (|| נִבְרֵאת אֲשֶׁר בִּמְקוֺם ); of Jerusalem, הַכְּנַעֲנִי מֵאֶרֶץ וּמֹלְדֹתַיִךְ מְכֹדֹתַיִךְ 16:3 .
definitions.rootNote: or מְכֹרָה ; from the same as 3564 in the sense of dipping ;
